stdout:
List subscriptions. Use this tool to list subscriptions.

Usage:
  yutu subscription list [flags]

Examples:
# List my subscriptions
yutu subscription list --for mine
# List subscriptions by channel ID with limit
yutu subscription list --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --maxResults 10
# List specific subscriptions in JSON format
yutu subscription list --ids abc123,def456 --output json
# List subscriptions for a channel alphabetically
yutu subscription list --forChannelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --order alphabetical

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string                       Return the subscriptions of the given channel owner
  -F, --for string                             mine|myRecentSubscribers|mySubscribers
  -C, --forChannelId string                    Return the subscriptions to the subset of these channels that the authenticated user is subscribed to
  -h, --help                                   help for list
  -i, --ids strings                            Return the subscriptions with the given ids for Stubby or Apiary
  -n, --maxResults int                         The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   YouTube channel ID linked to the content owner
  -O, --order string                           subscriptionOrderUnspecified|relevance|unread|alphabetical (default "relevance")
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                          Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])
